source: Bontekoe et al. 2023 Proc B, DOI 10.1098/rspb.2023.1268; original 3 CC0 Movebank Data Repository archived items
source_license_note: DataCite record for all 3 original archived studies explicitly reports CC0 1.0. Owner permission is not required for public CC0 datasets under Movebank General Terms; citation and reasonable outreach encouraged. No license terms will be programmatically accepted.

file_access.allow_exactly: .txt and .csv bitstreams exposed as public metadata within original bundle of each pinned item
file_access.disallow: .zip, .gpx, .kmz, .xlsx, .pdf, any tracking, GPS or accelerometer event rows or large datasets
file_access.content_url_source: Only DSpace bitstream metadata's declared content link with same hostname and exact UUID path
file_access.content_redirect_rule: Block redirection to unknown host; do not bypass authorization/accept terms
file_access.verify: Compare downloaded raw bytes with original public metadata MD5 before parsing; never impute/fix source

aggregate_only_output.csv: header field names, count of data rows, number of unique individuals ONLY if an explicit stable individual/tag identifier field exists; never IDs or source observations
aggregate_only_output.readme: plain boolean for timestamp, GPS, ACC, UTC, sampling interval, licensing, temporal overlap keywords; do not publish source prose
aggregate_only_output.files: file size, extension, MD5_verified Boolean; no filenames, GPS coordinates or rows
aggregate_only_output.do_not_claim: reference CSV records provide actual social contacts or predictive cue reliability; they are source-reference documentation only

scientific_gate: Do not open or fit any social-information × recourse effect until event-level time support, cross-study consistent individual IDs and independent predecision environmental reliability are verified; 2024 Bronnvik prior art already established age-specific conspecific density route preference
prior: PR #418 original six-code-notebook and metadata gate; standalone read-only DSpace source probe parent
